questions.question:
Given below is a pattern out of which a section has been cut. Select the option which, when placed correctly, will complete the pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9fb5fab2bedf494fa14e21deeeb0c8d2af1691b8ca01e8a47bbe12ad6cbf64f.png]
questions.solution:
The correct option that fits the given blank is shown below:

The logic followed here is: 

1) The right half of the figure is partly horizontally opposite to the left half of the figure.

2) The opposite region is shaded in the other half of the figure.

3) Half horizontal line is removed from the other half of the figure. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f50b6a43651584531fa757554b1fb17a0f93c59f8699234870b2c86e38bcde35.png] 

**Thus, Option Figure 3 completes the given pattern.**

Option 1) is incorrect because the top region is shaded instead of the bottom part.

Option 2) is incorrect because all the lines within the Pentagon part cut at the vertices, but in this, the straight vertical line is given which cuts at one of the edges. 

Option 4) is incorrect because in this the half horizontal line is not removed. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**

The logic followed here is:

Imagine the symbol as a person with 4 different thing.

1) Head consists of circle, triangle and square.

2) Body consists of Rectangle, line and oval.

3) Legs consist of line, coloured circle and uncoloured circle.

4) Both hands are upward, straight and downward.

In row wise they have the same pattern.

So in the blank space of third row, the symbol should have:

head -- square

body -- line

leg -- uncoloured circle

hands -- downward

Thus the figure in option 3 completes the given question pattern.

Hence, figure in **Option 3** is the correct answer.
